results.name: vector-editor-rig

results.name: tracing-beam

results.name: multi-device-splay

results.name: cursor-marquee-select

results.name: notification-stack
results.title: Notification Stack
results.description: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

results.name: vfx-iphone-device
results.title: iPhone & MacBook 3D Showcase
results.description: Real GLTF iPhone 15 Pro Max and MacBook Pro models with live HTML-in-Canvas screen content, morphing glass lens, product review camera choreography, and 360° turntable.

results.name: typed-prompt
results.title: Typed Prompt
results.description: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

results.name: sticky-mock-swap
results.title: Sticky Mock Swap
results.description: A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.

results.name: cursor-drag-drop
results.title: Drag and Drop Cursor
results.description: A cursor grabs a task card, lifts and tilts it into its motion, carries it in lockstep to an empty column, drops it with a small settle, and the list closes the gap behind it.

results.name: cursor-zoom-follow
results.title: Zoom Follow Cursor
results.description: Screen-recording auto-zoom: the camera pushes in toward each upcoming click, trails the cursor on a smooth spring, marks every click with a press and a ring, then eases back out to the full screen as the cursor leaves.

results.name: ui-focus-zoom
results.title: UI Focus Zoom
results.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

results.name: telemetry-hud
results.title: Telemetry HUD
results.description: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

results.name: state-chip-rail
results.title: State Chip Rail
results.description: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.

results.name: browser-device-stage
results.title: Browser Device Stage
results.description: A generic app surface in token-native device chrome (browser, window, or phone). The screen is a slot for caller img/video/HTML with a token-styled skeleton default; one settle entrance, a readable hold, and an optional screen swap.

results.name: spring-stack-shuffle
results.title: Spring Stack Shuffle
results.description: A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.

results.name: soft-blob-touch
results.title: Soft Blob Touch
results.description: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

results.name: code-terminal-run
results.title: Code Terminal Run
results.description: A token-chrome terminal panel runs one command: the prompt line types deterministically behind an integer-cycle caret, executes after a beat, and output lines print one per cue before a fresh prompt appears.

results.name: screen-flow-carousel
results.title: Screen Flow Carousel
results.description: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

results.name: segmentation-flood
results.title: Segmentation Flood
results.description: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

results.name: native-notification-pop
results.title: Native Notification Pop
results.description: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.

results.name: frost
results.title: Frost

results.name: colorama-wipe
results.title: Colorama Wipe
results.description: Headline reveal through a feathered, leaning wipe front that is blurred and colour-mapped as it passes, then settles to clean type and wipes off again — the After Effects masked-text + Compound Blur + Colorama 'shiny wipe' as a deterministic canvas effect on any text element

results.name: filmed-screen
results.title: Filmed Screen
results.description: Your scene, filmed off a screen: perspective, depth of field that follows an element you name, LED sub-pixels and per-shot colour grades. Shots glide into each other, focus racks between elements, and the focused element stays sharp.

results.name: whip-pan-cut
results.title: Whip Pan Cut
results.description: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: hw-boil
results.title: Hand-Drawn Boil
results.description: Hand-drawn jitter that re-poses every N frames, as seek-safe helpers: pose derives from quantized timeline time through a seeded hash; includes the shared onUpdate dispatcher, a wobbled-ellipse path generator, the boil pose control (off/calm/lively over the family-locked frameDrop), a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease, and the completed stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray — spray is index-seeded deterministic dots, no turbulence) with texture-safe draw-on
